info.title: Reporting API
info.description: Access automation, conversation and agent data in Pypestream..

get.description: Retrieves specific agent information identified by the agent ID.

parameters.description: The specific ID of the Agent to retrieve data for.
parameters.name: agent_id

200.description: Successful request with response body. If a request is for data over 30 days old, the response will be an empty array.

400.description: Incomplete or invalid input or from and to is incorrectly formatted.

403.description: Requested date range is greater than the maximum.

get.description: Retrieves agents' information between a specific 24-hour time frame.

200.description: Successful request with response body. If a request is for data over 30 days old, the response will be an empty array.

400.description: Incomplete or invalid input or from and to is incorrectly formatted.

403.description: Requested date range is greater than the maximum.

get.description: Retrieves a specific session's metadata identified by the Chat/Session ID.

parameters.description: Enables retrieval of Google Business Messages survey data.
parameters.name: include_survey

parameters.description: Enables retrieval of Flow completion data (as configured in the solution template).
parameters.name: flows

get.description: Retrieves metadata for multiple conversations between a specific time frame, no more than one hour apart.

parameters.description: Enables retrieval of Google Business Messages survey data.
parameters.name: include_survey

parameters.description: Enables retrieval of Flow completion data (as configured in the solution template).
parameters.name: flows

get.description: Retrieves a specific transcript identified by the Chat/Session ID.

parameters.description: Enables retrieval of Session Variables which include the prefix `RAPI_`.
parameters.name: sessionsVariables

get.description: Retrieves transcripts for multiple conversations between a specific time frame, no more than one hour apart.

parameters.description: Enables retrieval of Session Variables which include the prefix `RAPI_`.
parameters.name: sessionsVariables

parameters.description: Specifies if the results should only include completed conversations (only relevant if searching by the start time of the conversations).
parameters.name: completed_chats_only

parameters.description: Defines if the `to` & `from` parameters in the time frame refer to the session start time or the session end time (new feature, not currently deployed on all environments).
parameters.name: search_by

agent_id.description: ID of agent connected to Conversation.

agent_name.description: Name of agent connected to Conversation.

chats_assigned.description: Number of conversation assigned to the agent.

new_status.description: New agent status. The value can be online, away, busy, offline.

prev_status.description: Previous agent status. The value can be online, away, busy, offline.

ts.description: Agent status update timestamp in UTC time zone.

agents.description: Agents that participated in the Conversation.

agent_assign_ts.description: Date and time last agent connected to Conversation.

agent_msg_count.description: Cumulative number of messages sent by all agents connected to Conversation.

agent_id.description: ID of agent connected to Conversation.

agent_end_ts.description: Date and time when the agent leave the chat.

agent_email.description: Email of agent connected to Conversation.

agent_name.description: Name of agent connected to Conversation.

agent_response_ts.description: Date and time of first message sent by last agent connected to Conversation.

end_tags.description: List of tags set by last agent on disconnect.

skill.description: Contains skill tag from last connected agent, if set.

all_end_comments.description: A list including the value of end_comment and any additional comments set by agents or platform.

items.example: Ended as anonymous webchat user stopped heartbeating.

bots.description: Solutions that participated in the Conversation.

bot_end_ts.description: Date and time of disconnect for first use case connected to Conversation.

bot_id.description: Solution identifier of first use case connected to Conversation in "CustomerName.SolutionName" format.

bot_msg_count.description: Cumulative number of messages sent by all use cases connected to the Conversation.

bot_start_ts.description: Date and time of connect for first use case connected to Conversation.

bot_version.description: Solution version of first use case connected to Conversation.

convo_tags.description: List of tags associated with the conversation by the first use case connected to the Conversation.

kill_reason.description: Reason the first use case connected to the Conversation was terminated.

enum.description: Solution hits a node that ends the conversation or transfers to an agent.
Conversation times out and ends due to inactivity.
Unexpected error occurs that causes a conversation with a solution to end abnormally.

num_nodes.description: Number of nodes traversed in the use case graph by the first use case connected to the Conversation.

user_traversal_path.description: List of use case nodes that were followed in the course of the conversation with the first use case connected to the Conversation.

chat_start_ts.description: Start date and time of Conversation.

chat_end_ts.description: End date and time of Conversation.

consumer_msg_count.description: Number of messages sent by consumer in Conversation.

consumer_name.description: Name of end-user. While this field is always included, it may be listed as "Visitor" if the consumer name is not captured.

end_comment.description: Comment added by agent or system.
end_comment.example: Offered a discount on next purchase

flows.description: List of flows that the user traversed through during their session including details on the completion or abandonment of each flow.

pype_name.description: Name of Pype that Conversation occurred on.

stream_name.description: Name of Stream that Conversation was on.

survey_gateway.description: Name of the survey source. The value is `google_bm`.

survey_ts.description: Start time of the survey. For example `2020-05-27T07:36:40.601Z`.

all_end_comments: Ended as anonymous webchat user stopped heartbeating
Offered a discount on next purchase
example.end_comment: Offered a discount on next purchase

consumer.description: An object containing details about the end-user.

metadata.description: An object containing metadata values related to the conversation.

end_comment.description: End comment, if provided by an agent on conversation-end.

end_tags.description: End tags, if provided by an agent on conversation-end.

pype_name.description: Name of the pype in which the conversation occurred.

stream_name.description: Name of the stream in which the conversation occurred.

transcript.description: An array containing objects pertaining to each message sent or received in the conversation.

message.description: A string of the message sent or received.

participant.description: Name of the participant, which can be either a Solution, End-User, or an Agent.

seq_num.description: The sequence number of the message, starting at index 1. This value specified the order of the messages as they occurred.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the individual message. In UTC timezone.

type.description: Defines whether the message was sent by a solution, agent, or end-user.

sessionsVariables.description: If the sessionsVariables=true parameter is provided, it returns an object containing all session variables prefixed by _RAPI and their corresponding values. Any variables not including this prefix are excluded from reporting.

transcript.message: Id like to check my account balance
Can you help me reset my password?
